1. Overall Vehicle Registration Distribution by Category (Log Scale)¶

In [7]:
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6),dpi=150)
sns.barplot(x=reg_type.values, y=reg_type.index,hue=reg_type.index, palette="viridis")
plt.xscale('log') 
plt.title('Total Vehicle Registrations by Type in Maharashtra (2019-2024)',font='calibri',fontsize=20)
plt.xlabel('Number of Registrations (Log Scale)',font='calibri',fontsize=15)
plt.ylabel('Vehicle Type',font='calibri',fontsize=15)
plt.minorticks_on()
plt.grid(axis='x',which='both',linestyle=':',color='grey',alpha=0.7)
plt.show()

2. Longitudinal Registration Velocity & Macro Timeline Shifts¶

In [8]:
timeline = df_norm.groupby('date')['registrations'].sum().reset_index()

plt.figure(figsize=(15, 5))
plt.plot(timeline['date'], timeline['registrations'], marker='o',mfc='w',mec='k', color='#2b5c8f', linewidth=2, markersize=5)
plt.title('Monthly Vehicle Registration Velocity in Maharashtra (2019 - 2024)', fontsize=14)
plt.xlabel('Timeline', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Total Registrations Per Month', fontsize=12)
plt.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

3. Market Concentration: Top 10 Highest-Volume RTO Hubs¶

In [9]:
df_norm['office_clean'] = df_norm['office_name'].str.title().str.strip()

top_rtos = df_norm.groupby('office_clean')['registrations'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False).head(10)

plt.figure(figsize=(11, 5))
bar = sns.barplot(x=top_rtos.values, y=top_rtos.index, hue=top_rtos.index,palette="flare")

for container in bar.containers:
    plt.bar_label(container, fmt='%.0f', padding=3) 
plt.xlim(0,top_rtos.values.max()*1.1)
plt.ticklabel_format(axis='x',style='plain')
plt.title('Top 10 RTO Offices by Total Volume (2019-2024)', fontsize=15)
plt.xlabel('Total Registrations Count',fontsize=13)
plt.ylabel('RTO Office Location',fontsize=13)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

5. Vehicle Type Mapping¶

In [11]:
transport_mapping = {
    'Two Wheeler(Nt)': 'Personal',
    'Light Motor Vehicle': 'Personal',
    'Light Goods Vehicle': 'Commercial/Goods',
    'Three Wheeler(T)': 'Commercial/Passenger',
    'Heavy Goods Vehicle': 'Commercial/Goods',
    'Light Passenger Vehicle': 'Commercial/Passenger',
    'Other Than Mentioned Above': 'Other',
    'Medium Goods Vehicle': 'Commercial/Goods',
    'Medium Passenger Vehicle': 'Commercial/Passenger',
    'Heavy Passenger Vehicle': 'Commercial/Passenger',
    'Medium Motor Vehicle': 'Other',
    'Two Wheeler (Invalid Carriage)': 'Personal',
    'Heavy Motor Vehicle': 'Other',
    'Four Wheeler (Invalid Carriage)': 'Personal',
    'Three Wheeler(Nt)': 'Personal',
    'Two Wheeler(T)': 'Commercial/Passenger'
}

df_norm['use_type'] = df_norm['vehicle_type'].map(transport_mapping)

use_counts = df_norm.groupby('use_type')['registrations'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
print(use_counts)

6. Personal vs. Commercial Fleet Densities¶

In [12]:
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))
bar = sns.barplot(
    x=use_counts.values, 
    y=use_counts.index, 
    hue=use_counts.index, 
    palette="Set2", 
    legend=False
)

for container in bar.containers:
    labels = [f'{val:,.0f}' if val > 0 else '' for val in container.datavalues]
    plt.bar_label(container, labels=labels, padding=3)

plt.title('Vehicle Registration Split by Use Type in Maharashtra (2019-2024)', font='calibri', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Total Registrations (Log Scale)', font='calibri', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Use Type', font='calibri', fontsize=12)
plt.xscale('log')
plt.xlim(1,use_counts.values.max()**1.2)
plt.grid(axis='x', linestyle=':', alpha=0.6)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

7. Post-Pandemic Longitudinal Growth Trajectories by Fleet Segment¶

In [13]:
trend_pivot = df_norm.pivot_table(
    index='date', 
    columns='use_type', 
    values='registrations', 
    aggfunc='sum'
).fillna(0)

plt.figure(figsize=(14, 6))
for column in ['Personal', 'Commercial/Goods', 'Commercial/Passenger']:
    plt.plot(trend_pivot.index, trend_pivot[column], label=column, linewidth=2)

plt.title('Growth Trajectory: Personal vs Commercial Segments', font='calibri', fontsize=18)
plt.xlabel('Year', font='calibri', fontsize=13)
plt.ylabel('Monthly Registrations', font='calibri', fontsize=13)
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.5)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

8. Seasonal Footprint: Aggregated Monthly Registration Patterns (2019-2024)¶

In [14]:
df_norm['month'] = df_norm['date'].dt.month
df_norm['month_name'] = df_norm['date'].dt.strftime('%b')

seasonal_trend = df_norm.groupby(['month', 'month_name'])['registrations'].sum().reset_index()

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 5))
sns.lineplot(
    x='month_name', 
    y='registrations', 
    data=seasonal_trend, 
    marker='o', mfc='w',mec='k',ms=5,
    sort=False, 
    color='#46ccff', 
    linewidth=2
)
for i, v in enumerate(seasonal_trend['registrations']):
    plt.text(i,v+10000,f"{v/1000:,.2f}K")
plt.title('Seasonality Impact: Total Registrations by Month (Pooled 2019-2024)', font='calibri', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Month', font='calibri', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Aggregated Registrations', font='calibri', fontsize=12)
plt.ticklabel_format(axis='y',style='plain')
plt.grid(True, linestyle=':', alpha=0.6)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

9. Monthly Run-Rates across Top 5 RTO Hubs¶

In [15]:
top_5_rto_names = df_norm.groupby('office_clean')['registrations'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False).head(5).index

df_top5 = df_norm[df_norm['office_clean'].isin(top_5_rto_names)]

rto_timeline = df_top5.pivot_table(index='date', columns='office_clean', values='registrations', aggfunc='sum').fillna(0)

plt.figure(figsize=(15, 7),dpi=125)
for rto in top_5_rto_names:
    plt.plot(rto_timeline.index, rto_timeline[rto], label=rto, linewidth=2)

plt.title('Growth Trajectory of the Top 5 RTO Hubs in Maharashtra', font='calibri', fontsize=20)
plt.xlabel('Year', font='calibri', fontsize=15)
plt.ylabel('Monthly Registrations', font='calibri', fontsize=15)
plt.legend(title="RTO Location")
plt.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.5)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

10. Top 10 Fastest Growing RTO Hubs¶

In [17]:
df_norm['year'] = df_norm['date'].dt.year

annual_rto = df_norm[df_norm['year'].isin([2022, 2023])].pivot_table(
    index='office_clean', 
    columns='year', 
    values='registrations', 
    aggfunc='sum'
).dropna()

annual_rto['YoY_Growth_Pct'] = ((annual_rto[2023] - annual_rto[2022]) / annual_rto[2022]) * 100

top_growers = annual_rto[annual_rto[2022] > 10000].sort_values(by='YoY_Growth_Pct', ascending=False).head(10)

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 5))
bar = sns.barplot(
    x='YoY_Growth_Pct', 
    y=top_growers.index, 
    hue=top_growers.index, 
    data=top_growers, 
    palette='crest', 
    legend=False
)
for container in bar.containers:
    plt.bar_label(container, fmt='%.1f%%', padding=3)

plt.xlim(0,top_growers['YoY_Growth_Pct'].max()*1.1)
plt.title('Market Acceleration: Top 10 Fastest Growing RTO Hubs (YoY Pct Growth 2022-2023)', font='calibri', fontsize=15)
plt.xlabel('YoY Growth Rate (%)', font='calibri', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('RTO Location', font='calibri', fontsize=12)
plt.grid(axis='x', linestyle=':', alpha=0.5)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

11. Annual Growth of Invalid Carriage Registrations¶

In [18]:
df_accessible = df_norm[df_norm['vehicle_type'].str.contains('Invalid Carriage', case=False)]

accessible_trend = df_accessible.groupby('year')['registrations'].sum().reset_index()

plt.figure(figsize=(8, 4))
sns.barplot(
    x='year', 
    y='registrations', 
    data=accessible_trend, 
    hue='year', 
    palette='plasma', 
    legend=False
)
for i,v in enumerate(accessible_trend['registrations']):
    plt.text(x=i,y=v+20,s=f'{v:,.0f}',ha='center',font='calibri',fontsize=12)
    
plt.ylim(0,accessible_trend['registrations'].max()*1.1)

plt.title('Registration Trends for Accessible/Invalid Carriage Vehicles', font='calibri', fontsize=14)
plt.xlabel('Year')
plt.ylabel('Total Annual Registrations')
plt.grid(axis='y', linestyle=':', alpha=0.5)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

12. Structural Product Mix Matrix across Top 10 RTOs¶

In [19]:
top_10_names = top_rtos.index

df_top10 = df_norm[df_norm['office_clean'].isin(top_10_names)]

matrix_data = df_top10.pivot_table(
    index='office_clean', 
    columns='use_type', 
    values='registrations', 
    aggfunc='sum'
).fillna(0)

matrix_perc = matrix_data.div(matrix_data.sum(axis=1), axis=0) * 100

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8))
sns.heatmap(matrix_perc, annot=True, fmt=".2f", cmap="YlGnBu", cbar_kws={'label': 'Percentage of Total Market (%)'})
plt.title('Vehicle Ecosystem Profile: Product Mix Across Top 10 RTOs', font='calibri', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Use Classification', font='calibri', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('RTO Hub', font='calibri', fontsize=12)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

15. Macro Capacity Forecast: Historical Volume vs. 2024 Annualized Run-Rate¶

In [22]:
full_years = df_norm[df_norm['year'].isin([2021, 2022, 2023])].groupby('year')['registrations'].sum()

jan_may_2024_total = df_norm[df_norm['year'] == 2024]['registrations'].sum()
projected_2024 = (jan_may_2024_total / 5) * 12

projection_series = full_years.copy()
projection_series[2024] = projected_2024

plt.figure(figsize=(9, 5))
bars = plt.bar(projection_series.index.astype(str), projection_series.values, color=['#b2bec3', '#b2bec3', '#b2bec3', '#e74c3c'])
bars[-1].set_hatch('////') 
plt.title('Annual Registration Pace: Full Years vs. 2024 Projected Run-Rate', font='calibri', fontsize=16)
plt.ylabel('Total Annual Registrations',fontsize=15)
plt.ylim(0,projection_series.values.max()*1.1)
plt.ticklabel_format(axis='y',style='plain')
plt.grid(axis='y', linestyle=':', alpha=0.7)

for i, v  in enumerate(projection_series.values):
    plt.text(i,v ,f'{v:,.0f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

16. Industrial Logistics Audit: Fleet Sub-Category Density Map (2019-2024)¶

In [23]:
df_commercial = df_norm[df_norm['use_type'].isin(['Commercial/Goods', 'Commercial/Passenger'])]

commercial_pivot = df_commercial.pivot_table(
    index='vehicle_type', 
    columns='year', 
    values='registrations',

).fillna(0)

plt.title('Commercial Fleet Registration Breakdown (2019-2024)', font='calibri', fontsize=20)
